source.titleEn: The power of a man to beat his wife: a critical study of the book Darb al-Mar'ah of Abdul Hamid Abu Sulayman
source.author: Habeebullah Zakariyah

summary.en: A critical study of Abū Sulaymān's book. Keeps al-ḍarb as a touch or light strike. Ties the permission to maṣlaḥa, so a permitted strike can become disliked or forbidden, and concludes that the government may restrict or prevent it when it does not serve the purposes of the Sharia.
